versions.changelog:
- Added documentation for starter credit: new accounts may receive a one-time welcome credit, detailed in the registration response as welcome_credits_usd.
- Clarified usage limits and eligibility: daily caps and per-IP limits for starter credit are explained.
- No changes to APIs or features; update is documentation-only.

- Added instructions for using ApexApi as an optional MCP server (local and remote).
- Updated documentation section to include MCP usage and links to relevant docs.
- No changes to API functions or endpoints.

- Initial release of apexapi skill (version 1.0.0).
- Enables access to 120+ AI models and live web data (scraping, crawling, extraction) via a unified API key.
- Agent-native: agents can self-register and self-fund using card or USDC on Base; no human required.
- OpenAI-compatible endpoints for chat, images, and video models.
- Comprehensive web integration: scrape pages, crawl entire sites, and extract structured data from various web sources.
- Security guidance and recovery instructions included.
